messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Olivia Tran <olivia.tran@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prep: weekly forecast submission — last-mile guidance & precall

Team,

This is the final nudge for weekly forecast submission (Q3 window). Finance will pull numbers at 5pm PT tomorrow, so we need all updates in HubSpot and the attached spreadsheet by 4:30pm PT to give us a 30m buffer for basic QC.

Top asks (please action by EOD tomorrow unless noted):
- Update stage and commit confidence in HubSpot for any deals with movement this week (specifically: stage, expected close date, and rationale for change).
- Populate the "last-mile" column in the attached forecast_template_q3.xlsx with the gating item (e.g., PO, legal redline, exec signoff) and the owner.
- If the deal requires a pricing exception >20% or extended payment terms, flag in HubSpot and DM me — we'll route to RevOps for approval.

Precall (Thursday 4:45pm PT, 30m):
1) Quick roll-up of high-risk deals (> $150k) — owners confirm readiness to commit.
2) Any stalled deals with new asks (pricing/terms/security).
3) One-sentence blockers and requested next step from Redwood.

I've attached a short precall-deck.pdf with the suggested slide template and the forecast spreadsheet. If you have a deal that needs to be discussed but you won't make the call, add a 1-line summary in the shared doc and mark me as follow-up owner.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>

Kim — thanks for the heads up. A quick note on Acme Analytics:
- Their procurement team (cc'd) asked for a timeline-confirmed quote yesterday; legal is reviewing our standard MSA (minor redlines expected).
- I'll update HubSpot with the new expected close (9/30) and mark the gating item as "legal review" with Marissa owning the follow-up.

I will bring the status and ask to the precall — might need 5 minutes for context.

Karthik
